newsitem.title: USA: Medical Graphics signs German distributor.
newsitem.headline: Medical Graphics signs German distributor.

text.p: Medical Graphics Corp said Tuesday it signed an agreement making Oxford Instruments GmbH the exclusive distributor and service agent for its MedGraphics systems in Germany.
The company closed its office in Dusseldorf at the end of December and has been looking for a more cost-effective distribution channel for its nearly 200 German customers.
A final agreement is expected to be signed by May 1, Medical Graphics said.
Medical Graphics markets non-invasive cardiorespiratory diagnostic systems to treat heart and lung diseases.
Its shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 3-3/8.
